entry.title: New: Resolution 370 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE ACCEPTANCE OF A DONATION OF AN ADA-COMPLIANT ELKAY WATER REFILLING STATION WITH INSTALLATION TO THE DEPARTMENT OF PARKS AND RECREATION

The donation from Keiki of Da Aina Foundation, with an estimated value of $2,000, would be installed at the Kekuaokalani Gymnasium in Kailua-Kona.
